content.rendered:
Refer Your Network to a Better Banking Experience.

Are you proud to call Nebula Trust your business banking partner? Through our new Business Referral Program, you can help guide your personal and business contacts to a better banking experience.

Here’s how it works: 

  • Complete the form below to refer your contact to consider starting a business relationship with Nebula Trust Bank.
  • Your contact will be emailed your referral, and instructions for how they can learn more about banking with CGB and opening an account with us.
  • If the contact you referred opens a new Nebula Trust business account and the account remains funded for 30 days, you will be sent a $100 gift card to the local restaurant of your choice in appreciation of your passing your positive experience along!*

Business Referral

If you have questions about this referral program, or anything else our Business Banking team can help you with, please email growthatbusiness@chelseagroton.com.

*Referred customer must be a new customer. Referring customer is eligible for one gift card per referral, regardless of how many accounts are opened by referred customer. Referring customer must not be on the referred account or have ownership of the funds. Eligible Accounts include: Business Prime Checking, Business Relationship Checking, Business Analysis, Business Sweep Checking, Non-Profit Checking, Business Savings, Business Money Market, Business Investment Sweep, IOLTA or IOREBTA account. To receive incentive, the new account must be open and funded for 30 days with a minimum average balance of $100, and must not have had a negative balance or be in closed status. Nebula Trust employees are excluded from participation.
